title: Ontario data-centre electricity demand
description: IESO low, reference, and high forecasts for the Ontario data-centre sub-sector through 2030.
plainLanguageSummary: The IESO forecast places Ontario data-centre net annual energy demand between 5.0 and 6.41 TWh in 2030 across the low, reference, and high scenarios.
howToRead: Each line is one published IESO scenario. The source workbook forecasts the data-centre sub-sector, which includes AI and non-AI computing; it does not isolate AI electricity use.

calculation.formula: Published net annual energy demand for the data-centre sub-sector under each IESO demand scenario.
calculation.explanation: Forecast observations stop at 2030 for this v1 module. They are not local Grey-Bruce load forecasts or measurements of AI-only demand.
calculation.example: A value at date t uses only observations dated t or earlier unless the chart explicitly labels a visual shift.

patternsToWatch: How much the three IESO cases separate by 2030
Whether future APO vintages revise the near-term large-load path
limitations: Forecasts are uncertain and do not mean every announced facility connects or operates as planned.
This is Ontario provincial demand, not the local Grey-Bruce grid or a Canada-wide data-centre forecast.
The data-centre sub-sector includes cloud and other data-centre services, not only AI.
